# Hale's Boarwood Bounty

*Ranger Hale pays a bounty for keeping the Boarwood's herd back from the farms: defeat 40 boars in the Boarwood. He will pay it again, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 Boarwood boars ([Hedge Boar](../monsters/hedge_boar.md), [Rooting Piglet](../monsters/rooting_piglet.md), [Tusker](../monsters/tusker.md))

## Rewards

- 3,500 EXP
- 1,500 mesos
- [Iron Ingot](../items/iron_ingot.md) x1

The first time you complete it instead: 5,000 EXP, 2,500 mesos, +30 standing with Kaldemor
